column1: # What bus is coming: AT's realtime feed labels every bus with its operator's
# code and fleet number ("TR3884", "NB5014"). This maps fleet number ranges to
# a model in models.json. tools/fleet_survey.py (a step in every CI build)
# lists the ranges on the road that aren't covered here yet.
# Tab-separated: prefix, first, last, model id (see models.json)
# Source: the AT Metro Wiki's model and operator pages (atmetro.fandom.com,
# CC BY-SA), checked against the ranges the survey sees on the road.
# Ritchies, including the ex-Birkenhead Transport and ex-Pavlovich fleets
